newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-TAURAS BANK SHARES SUSPENDED FROM TRADING.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-TAURAS BANK SHARES SUSPENDED FROM TRADING.

text.p: The board of the stock exchange has suspended trade in the shares of troubled Tauras Bank, the stock exchange said Tuesday.
The suspension by the stock exchange followed the decision of the central bank last Thursday to remove Tauras Bank's board and impose restrictions on most of its activities.
The Bank of Lithuania also launched an audit of Tauras.
Tauras Bank has said that it was pinning its hopes to stay on its feet on a 40 million litas new share issue.
The securities commission on Friday ordered the bank to inform creditors about its situation and said the bank would have to repay those who had suscribed to the issue.
